name: § 21, after point a – 86
title: REPORT on the Council position on the draft general budget of the European Union for the financial year 2027
part_text: (ac) Emphasises the consequences of the EU-Mercosur agreement for European farmers, who face increased competition from imported agricultural products; refuses to accept that European farmers should bear the brunt of unfair competition resulting from differences in standards; calls on the Commission to ensure effective reciprocity of standards and to take the necessary measures to protect the most vulnerable European agricultural sectors;
